title.narrative: EU Support to Social Housing and Active Inclusion in Serbia

description.narrative: The European Union Support to Social Housing and Active Inclusion Programme, aimed to enhance the outcome of the social inclusion policies in Serbia, is based on the Serbia Local Development Action Document within the Instrument for Pre-accession Assistance (IPA) 2018. The Programme will strengthen the overall institutional capacity for the implementation of sustainable social housing and effective active inclusion policy. Particularly targeted groups are vulnerable and at-risk-of-poverty population categories, such as persons with disabilities, disadvantaged women, in particular woman victims of domestic violence, youth in/leaving care, Roma, etc. who live in inadequate or insecure housing conditions.\nAs a result of the Programme, national and local authorities, as well as other relevant institutions and organisations, will be capacitated to formulate and implement relevant specific programmes, measures and actions; adequate housing solutions will be provided to the most vulnerable groups; and integrated job, social, educational and health care services, complementary to housing solutions, will be made available.\n
